normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Private pool- 7 adult bikes- Ping pong table- Foosball table- Borders Camp Helen State Park- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Days of golden sunshine and glamorous luxury await at Park Place Pearl—the gem of Inlet Beach! Accommodating 24 guests, with 7 bedrooms, 7 full bathrooms, and 2 half baths, this home is perfect for large groups or multi-family trips and boasts a private pool, multiple outdoor spaces, and walkable beach access—only 7 minutes away! Worries disappear inside this inviting 3-level beach abode. White shiplap walls and wide-plank hardwoods adorn the elegant first-floor great room. The open kitchen is well-equipped for sizable groups with 2 refrigerators, 2 dishwashers, and a spacious 6-stool breakfast bar. For formal dining, 2 dining tables collectively seat 16. A soft sectional and 2 lounge chairs provide a comfy gathering spot for relaxing movie nights. Venture onto the furnished porch for shade and fresh air or unwind by the sparkling pool and sitting spa. When hunger strikes, fire up the propane grill and enjoy an alfresco meal at the 6-seat table. At the end of the night, retire to the guest bedroom with a king bed on this level—all the home’s bedrooms feature a private bathroom. For convenience, the laundry room has 3 sets of stacked washers and dryers. Take the stairs or in-home elevator to the second level, where a primary bedroom and 3 guest bedrooms, each with a king bed, await. The primary bedroom and first guest bedroom share deck access. Guests will love unwinding in the third-level living space, complete with a sectional, TV, ping-pong table, foosball table, and kitchenette. Soft seating, a Smart TV, and chaise loungers on the patio invite guests to savor the temperate weather and stunning Gulf views. There are 2 comfortable bunk rooms—the first has 2 queen-over-queen beds, and the second has 1 queen-over-queen and 1 XL twin-over-twin. Park Place Pearl is the perfect setting for making precious memories and enjoying all the treasures of Inlet Beach. Parking for 5 vehicles—plus 7 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger, low-speed vehicle—makes exploring effortless. The nearest beach access is Phillips Inlet Beach Access, a 7-minute walk down Walton Magnolia Lane. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 24):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower onlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 1 Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed and 1 XL Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only
